title: Uniform average cost and leaf count
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates, with leaves labelled in any type. When each coordinate is independently uniform on $\{-1,1\}$, the average number of queries made by $T$ is at most $\log_2 L$, where $L$ is the number of leaves of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates over the sign alphabet $\{-1,1\}$
